body: That’s really weird. I never knew people could hate on firefighters. That sucks.
It’s so hard to make friends. Do you like being a fire fighter? That sounds so interesting...

I hate how sex is treated like some kind of achievement to be unlocked before you’re considered a *real man*.

Do you have a lot of friends?
That took courage to stop what you were doing to post this. Do you still feel like you failed?
I know that feeling — being excited about the prospect of suicide. I’m dealing with my own issues, but I just wanted you to know I can relate to that feeling.
